title: The wall
summary: Your old primary school wants to paint you on the playground wall. Your mum has already said yes. The painter has never seen you play. A season on, the kids have added something.

ends.title: The mural
ends.text: There's a painting of you on your old primary school's playground wall. It looks a bit like you. The kids have given you a moustache.

ends.title: No wall
ends.text: You said no to the playground wall. They painted a rainbow instead. It's a very good rainbow.

beats.title: The wall

event.title: The wall
event.speaker: mum
setup: {mum.short}: "Your old school wants to paint you on the playground wall. I've already said yes. The man doing it does dragons, mostly."

say: "He wants a photo. Not a posh one. One of you as a lad, in the old kit. I've got just the one." You know which one. It has a bowl cut.

replies.label: "Go on, then. Send him the bowl cut."
"Mum. No. Ask them to paint something else."

yes.text: The man who does dragons paints the bowl cut eight feet high. The whole school comes out to watch the last brushstroke.

new.text: She sends the bowl cut anyway. "He liked it better."

no.text: "Fine. A rainbow." She sounds like she's been told she can't have a dog.

beats.hint: Your old school has an idea

event.title: The playground
event.speaker: mum
setup: A season on, your mum sends a photo from the school gates.

{if arc.path=='yes'}The bowl cut, eight feet high. Someone has drawn a moustache on it in chalk.{/if}{if arc.path=='no'}The rainbow. Underneath it, in chalk, someone has written your name anyway.{/if}

outcomes.text: Break time. A hundred kids. One of them points at you, then at the wall, then at you. "Where's your moustache?"
The rainbow's very good. The kids show you your name in chalk, proudly. You sign the wall under it.
"I'm not having it cleaned," says your mum. "It suits you."
"It's a lovely rainbow," says your mum, for the hundredth time.
